run_sym_diff_compare_lists: run sym_diff to compare two symbol list files and output the differences to stdout
run_sym_diff_removed_only: run sym_diff with --removed-only to show only symbols removed between two symbol lists
run_sym_diff_names_only: run sym_diff with --names-only to print only symbol names without full details
run_sym_diff_stdlib_filter: run sym_diff with --only-stdlib-symbols to filter and compare only stdlib-related symbols
run_sym_diff_strict_output: run sym_diff with --strict and -o to write diff report to file and exit non-zero on differences
